Reconciling all eleven workpapers against the verbatim DSL, code-diagram and design excerpts into one standalone design verdict.

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
- The decisive step is cross-slice arbitration: several "mechanism absent" claims from early slices (pairing contract, Binder acquisition, backpressure, startup cache reuse, lease renewal) are resolved by the later normative "round013" section, so they are recorded as verified resolutions rather than defects.
- Conversely, things only the verbatim DSL and code-diagrams can prove (no transport→callbacks edge, same class with different members per block, ADB attributed to ArcEngine) are confirmed directly from source and stay as defects.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`
